title: PlateEvent
description: Schema for a jitterbugs license plate recognition evidence package. All fields are required unless otherwise noted. Plain plate text is not stored by default; use plate_hash for analytics.

event_id.description: Unique identifier for this plate event (UUID v4).

device_id.description: Identifier of the camera/device that captured the plate.

timestamp_utc.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of when the plate was captured (e.g. 2024-06-01T12:34:56Z).

location.description: Geographic location of the capturing device at the time of the event.

accuracy_m.description: Estimated location accuracy radius in metres.

plate_text.description: Normalised plain-text plate string (uppercase, whitespace stripped). NULL when store_plain_plate_text policy is false. Must be null unless the site policy explicitly permits storing plain plate text.

plate_confidence.description: OCR confidence score for the plate text, in the range [0, 1].

plate_hash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of (normalised_plate_text + site_salt). Used for analytics and de-duplication without storing the raw plate. site_salt is a site-specific secret defined in plate_policy.yaml.

bounding_box.description: Pixel coordinates of the detected plate bounding box in the source frame.

x.description: Left edge of the bounding box in pixels.

y.description: Top edge of the bounding box in pixels.

width.description: Width of the bounding box in pixels.

height.description: Height of the bounding box in pixels.

clip_url.description: URL or path to the short video/image clip evidence file. NULL if no clip is stored (policy or storage unavailable). Must be access-controlled and retained only for the duration defined in plate_policy.yaml.

model_version.description: Identifier of the detector and OCR model versions used (e.g. 'yolov8n-lp-v1/easyocr-1.7.1').

device_manifest_ref.description: Reference (e.g. content hash or URL) to the device manifest used to verify device identity and software version at the time of capture.

signed_by_device.description: Base64-encoded device signature over the canonical JSON of this event (all fields except signed_by_device itself). Used for chain-of-custody verification.

match_source.description: Source of any watchlist or operator match. NULL if no match was found or lookup was not performed. 'operator_manual' indicates a human operator flagged this event.

match_confidence.description: Confidence of the watchlist/operator match in the range [0, 1]. NULL if match_source is null.

notes.description: Free-text operator notes attached during human review. NULL before review or if no notes were added.
